description: Hidrografía de las aguas superficiales de la CAPV: masas de agua de categoría río, transición, costeras, embalses, zonas húmedas, artificiales, lagos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. EAE-ko hidrografiaren kartografia. Ur-masak sailkatzen dira. Ur-masen sailkapenaren arabera geruza bat sortzen da, eta bakoitzaren arro isurialdeak ezartzen dira. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. The portal shows the English title as "EAEko lurrazaleko uren hidrografia: ibai kategoriako ur-masak, tarteko urak, kostaldeko urak, urtegiak, hezeguneak, ur a" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. Its keywords include Urtegia, Aguas, Río, Costa, Embalse, Aintzira. The listing shows 6 download or service links in X-ZIPPED-SHP, WMS. The listing shows 2025-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
